headings.title: Creation and responsibilities of the division
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Division of Alcohol and Drug Abuse within the department to supervise and oversee facilities and services.

headings.title: Powers, functions, and duties of the division
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates sixteen specific powers, functions, and duties of the division regarding planning, research, standards, and funding.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 631.010 establishing the Division of Alcohol and Drug Abuse and specifying its sixteen statutory powers, functions, and duties (L. 1980 H.B. 1724).

headings.title: Advisory council role and membership size
headings.reviewNote: Designates the Missouri advisory council on alcohol and drug abuse as an advisory body to the division and division director with up to twenty-five members (footnotes note transfer to DMH under § 630.003 and original-roll typo 'first' for 'second').

headings.title: Council appointments, terms, and composition requirements
headings.reviewNote: Governs director appointments, three-year staggered terms, consumer and veteran representation, and vendor limits.

headings.title: Filling of council vacancies by director
headings.reviewNote: Directs that vacancies occurring on the advisory council are filled by appointment of the director.

headings.title: Meetings and election of council chairman
headings.reviewNote: Provides that council meetings are called by the division director or the council chairman elected by members.

headings.title: Reimbursement of reasonable and necessary expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires reimbursement of each member's reasonable and necessary expenses, including travel expenses under department employee regulations, incurred in performing official duties.

headings.title: Subcouncils and study and recommendation duties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes division of the council into subcouncils and tasks it with studying and planning prevention and treatment services.

headings.title: Conflict of interest restrictions and member removal
headings.reviewNote: Bars members from participating in decisions involving personal interest or income and establishes removal grounds.

headings.title: State plan collaboration and advisory responsibilities
headings.reviewNote: Outlines council advisory duties including meetings, technology review, delivery recommendations, and standards development.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsection headings for 631.020 detailing the Missouri advisory council on alcohol and drug abuse structure, terms, governance, expense reimbursement, ethics, and duties (L. 1980 H.B. 1724, A.L. 1991 S.B. 125 & 341; effective 7-01-92; footnotes note transfer under § 630.003 and original-roll typo 'first' for 'second').

headings.title: Preparation and annual revision of state plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to prepare and annually revise a coordinated state plan for alcohol and drug abuse services.

headings.title: Mandatory contents and elements of state plan
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required elements of the state plan including needs assessments, goals, inventories, evaluations, and rules.

headings.title: Consideration of regional plans in preparation
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that the department take regional plans into consideration when preparing the statewide plan.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 631.030 governing preparation, annual revision, mandatory contents, and regional plan consideration for the state alcohol and drug abuse plan (L. 1980 H.B. 1724).

headings.title: Establishment and appointment of regional advisory councils
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department director to establish regional councils and requires the division director to appoint up to twenty regional residents for staggered three-year terms.

headings.title: Consumer representation and vendor membership limitations
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least one-half consumer membership and limits vendor participation to no more than one-fourth.

headings.title: Conflict of interest prohibition and removal grounds
headings.reviewNote: Bars regional members from participating in decisions involving personal interest or income and authorizes removal.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 631.040 authorizing regional advisory councils, consumer/vendor composition limits, and conflict of interest restrictions (L. 1980 H.B. 1724).

headings.title: Participation and contents of regional plans
headings.reviewNote: Requires regional councils to participate in preparing, reviewing, and recommending regional plans with inventories and goals.

headings.title: Appropriations condition for regional council staff
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that any regional advisory council staff shall be provided only from funds appropriated specifically for that purpose, effective July 1, 1981.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 631.045 establishing regional plan participation/contents and staff appropriation condition (L. 1980 H.B. 1724; footnote notes subsection 2 effective 7-01-81).

headings.title: Discharge of voluntary client by facility head
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the facility head to discharge any voluntary client whose continued stay is no longer beneficial or effective.

headings.title: Client release requests and involuntary detention exception
headings.reviewNote: Requires release upon written request unless the facility head initiates involuntary detention due to likelihood of serious harm.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 631.110 governing voluntary client discharge by facility head and written release requests with involuntary detention exception (L. 1985 S.B. 265, A.L. 1996 S.B. 884 & 841).

headings.title: Adult application for involuntary detention and treatment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes any adult person to file a court application for detention and treatment of a person presenting likelihood of serious harm.

headings.title: Applicability of section 632.305 court procedures
headings.reviewNote: Applies section 632.305 procedures for judicial disposition and detention orders for up to ninety-six hours.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 631.115 governing adult probate court applications and section 632.305 ninety-six-hour detention procedures (L. 1985 S.B. 265, A.L. 1996 S.B. 884 & 841).

headings.title: Application by professional or peace officer
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes mental health professionals, peace officers, nurses, physicians, or counselors to apply for emergency detention.

headings.title: Peace officer emergency custody and facility conveyance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes peace officers to take persons into custody upon reasonable cause of imminent harm and convey them to a facility.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 631.120 authorizing professionals and peace officers to apply for 96-hour detention and peace officer emergency custody/conveyance (L. 1985 S.B. 265 through A.L. 2023 S.B. 106).

headings.title: Detention extension pending thirty-day petition
headings.reviewNote: Permits detention for an additional two judicial days if the facility head files a petition for thirty days additional detention.

headings.title: Petition requirements for thirty-day involuntary detention
headings.reviewNote: Specifies filing deadlines, service requirements, and mandatory allegations for a thirty-day detention petition.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 631.140 governing two-judicial-day detention extensions and 30-day involuntary detention petition requirements (L. 1985 S.B. 265 through A.L. 2023 S.B. 106).

headings.title: Filing, hearing schedule, notice, and continuances
headings.reviewNote: Requires hearing within two judicial days of petition filing, prompt notice, and restricts continuances to good cause.

headings.title: Hearing conduct and procedural rights of respondent
headings.reviewNote: Requires informal hearing setting and enumerates respondent rights including counsel, evidence, cross-examination, and silence.

headings.title: Requirement and exceptions for respondent presence
headings.reviewNote: Mandates respondent presence unless waived by refusal, physical incapacity, or disruptive courtroom conduct.

headings.title: Clear and convincing standard for thirty-day order
headings.reviewNote: Directs court to order up to thirty days detention in least restrictive environment upon clear and convincing evidence.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 631.145 establishing 30-day hearing timelines, respondent procedural rights, presence exceptions, and clear and convincing detention standard (L. 1985 S.B. 265, A.L. 1996 S.B. 884 & 841).

headings.title: Additional detention for up to ninety days
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court after hearing to order additional detention up to ninety days if likelihood of serious harm continues.

headings.title: Facility petition filing and hearing procedures
headings.reviewNote: Requires petition within twenty-five days, sets hearing within four judicial days, and mandates treatment plan attachment.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 631.150 governing 90-day additional detention authorization and facility petition, hearing, and treatment plan requirements (L. 1985 S.B. 265 through A.L. 2023 S.B. 106).
